title: Service Cutaway & Error Chronology Explorer
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build a lightweight interactive dashboard and accompanying pipeline transforms that let SREs and oncall engineers slice an invocation timeline (cutaway) for a single request across infra/model/serving boundaries and surface an "error chronology" — a timestamped sequence of events and inferred root-cause signals (timeouts, overload, model-rejection, gRPC/HTTP error codes, KV cache miss, memory signs). This ticket implements the backend enrichment and a first-pass dashboard prototype for runtime investigation and SLA postmortems.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline: tracing hook processor emits 'cutaway_v1' envelope for sampled requests containing ordered events (ingress, queue_time_ms, kernel_alloc_ms, model_call_start/end, kv_cache_hit, model_reject, http_status, grpc_code)

Enrichment: metrics/log pipeline joins span data with per-request runtime metrics (queue/backpressure, GPU utilization, retry_count) and annotates probable class: timeout | overload | model_error | transport_error

Dashboard: 'Cutaway Explorer' view displays timeline for a selected request id showing colored bands per subsystem, expandable event details, and a top-level inferred failure label with confidence score
Querying: dashboard can filter by inferred failure class, model id, route, and time window, returning < 5s for a 1M-row sample index
Oncall workflow: dashboard includes one-click links to related GitHub PR/builds and the incident runbook, and a 'Mark investigated' action that persists notes
Tests: unit tests for enrichment rules and e2e job validating preservation of event order under up to 2s ingestion skew
technical_notes: Design notes: use existing tracehook v2 agent to emit a compact event sequence per request (proto: cutaway_v1). Implement enrichment as a streaming transform in the observability pipeline (Kafka -> Flink job) that implements deterministic ordering by event timestamp and a watermark policy to bound reordering. Failure classifier is rule-first: timeout if tail latency > route_slo and last event is 'client_timeout' or 'model_timeout'; overload if queue_time_ms > 95th percentile or host_cpu/gpu_pressure > threshold; model_error if model returned non-empty rejection or tokenization error; transport_error for 4xx/5xx and grpc non-OK. Each classifier outputs label, confidence_bucket, and evidence list. For dashboard storage use existing OLAP index (ClickHouse) with a new table cutaway_index_v1 partitioned by day. Privacy: redact any prompt/response payloads; only keep token-count and hashes. Performance: enrichment job should add <30ms P50 and support 8k reqs/s with autoscaling. Rollout: start with 10% sampling for all routes, 100% for critical customer routes in dedicated tier.
implementation_steps: Spec: finalize cutaway_v1 proto and event schema (tracehook + runtime agents)
Pipeline: implement Flink enrichment job + tests; add Kafka topic and schema registry entries
Index: migrate schema in ClickHouse and create materialized view for dashboard queries
Dashboard: React prototype in Console that queries cutaway_index_v1 and renders timeline component
QA: simulate skewed event arrival and validate ordering/watermark behaviour
Rollout: enable 10% sampling in hosted region_us-west-2; add feature flag for 100% on select routes
